name: WdMailMergeComparison
description: Specifies the type of comparison to use when a condition is added to a mail merge process.

constants.name: wdMergeIfEqual
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is equal to a value.

constants.name: wdMergeIfNotEqual
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is not equal to a value.

constants.name: wdMergeIfLessThan
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is less than a value.

constants.name: wdMergeIfGreaterThan
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is greater than a value.

constants.name: wdMergeIfLessThanOrEqual
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is less than or equal to a value.

constants.name: wdMergeIfGreaterThanOrEqual
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is greater than or equal to a value.

constants.name: wdMergeIfIsBlank
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is blank.

constants.name: wdMergeIfIsNotBlank
constants.description: A value is output if the mail merge field is not blank.
